principle: Freeze the rendering architecture, not the hat catalog.
invariants: native hybrid edits are bounded feature deltas only
alpha geometry is preserved unless a new authored construction explicitly defines new geometry
approved source outline pixels are preserved by hybrid enhancement
capacity, taste, exclusions, and human review remain authoritative
failed hybrid safety gates return exact golden/source-respecting pixels
newFamilyProtocol: Add a family contract, source/construction states, capacity/taste rules, region semantics, approved golden states, then render through HAT_RENDERER_V1. Do not redesign the renderer for ordinary catalog growth.
rendererChangePolicy: Any renderer-architecture change requires an explicit new renderer contract version and human approval.
